'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Steve Baroni DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Steve Baroni]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Sheet '''Baroni''' / deck '''WE ARE OLD AND NO FUN ANYMORE'''; dest [[Steve Baroni]]. Shorthand expanded; some titles normalized.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V) (Virtual Block 2)|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
